title: Bioinformatics for Every Biologist — companion files (data and scripts)
description: Practice data, scripts, the conda environment file and corrections for the book Bioinformatics for Every Biologist: Start modern research from home with free tools and AI by K.K. Sahu. Scripts are under the MIT licence; data files and text under CC BY 4.0. Sequence records come from public databases and remain under their terms.

creators.affiliation: Former Professor of Botany, L.N. Mithila University, Darbhanga, Bihar, India
